exercises.prompt: 画 $y=\sin x$，$-360^\circ\le x\le360^\circ$。a) x截距？b) y截距？c) 定义域、值域、周期？d) 最大值？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 正弦的零点给横截距 $-360^\circ,-180^\circ,0^\circ,180^\circ,360^\circ$；b) 代 $x=0$ 得 $y=0$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: c) 函数本身定义域为实数；本次绘图区间为 $[-360^\circ,360^\circ]$。值域 $[-1,1]$，基本周期360°。d) 最大值1。

en.prompt: Sketch $y=\sin x$ for $-360^\circ\le x\le360^\circ$. a) Find x-intercepts. b) Find the y-intercept. c) State domain, range, and period. d) State the greatest value.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Zeros of sin give x-intercepts $-360^\circ,-180^\circ,0^\circ,180^\circ,360^\circ$; b) set $x=0$ to obtain $y=0$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: c) The full function has real domain; the requested plotted restriction is $[-360^\circ,360^\circ]$. Range is $[-1,1]$ and fundamental period is 360°. d) Maximum is 1.

en.answer: a) $-360^\circ,-180^\circ,0^\circ,180^\circ,360^\circ$; b) $(0,0)$; c) all real x, restricted as plotted, range $[-1,1]$, period360°; d)1.

exercises.prompt: 画 $y=\cos x$，$-360^\circ\le x\le360^\circ$。a) x截距？b) y截距？c) 定义域、值域、周期？d) 最大值？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 余弦的零点给横截距 $-270^\circ,-90^\circ,90^\circ,270^\circ$；b) 代 $x=0$ 得 $y=1$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: c) 函数本身定义域为实数；本次绘图区间为 $[-360^\circ,360^\circ]$。值域 $[-1,1]$，基本周期360°。d) 最大值1。

en.prompt: Sketch $y=\cos x$ for $-360^\circ\le x\le360^\circ$. a) Find x-intercepts. b) Find the y-intercept. c) State domain, range, and period. d) State the greatest value.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Zeros of cos give x-intercepts $-270^\circ,-90^\circ,90^\circ,270^\circ$; b) set $x=0$ to obtain $y=1$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: c) The full function has real domain; the requested plotted restriction is $[-360^\circ,360^\circ]$. Range is $[-1,1]$ and fundamental period is 360°. d) Maximum is 1.

en.answer: a) $-270^\circ,-90^\circ,90^\circ,270^\circ$; b) $(0,1)$; c) all real x, restricted as plotted, range $[-1,1]$, period360°; d)1.

exercises.prompt: 把函数与所附A–D图匹配：a) $y=\sin x$；b) $y=\sin2x$；c) $y=-\sin x$；d) $y=\frac12\sin x$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: A从原点上升，振幅1、周期 $2\pi$；B从原点下降、周期 $2\pi$；C振幅1/2；D一段 $2\pi$ 含两周期。

exercises.answer: a) A；b) D；c) B；d) C。

en.prompt: Match the functions to given graphs A–D: a) $y=\sin x$; b) $y=\sin2x$; c) $y=-\sin x$; d) $y=\frac12\sin x$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: A rises through the origin with amplitude1 and period $2\pi$; B falls through it with period $2\pi$; C has amplitude1/2; D completes two cycles in $2\pi$.

en.answer: a) A; b) D; c) B; d) C.

exercises.prompt: 不画图求振幅和弧度/角度周期：a)$y=-3\sin2x$；b)$y=4\cos0.5x$；c)$y=\frac13\sin(5x/6)$；d)$y=-5\cos(3x/2)$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 统一使用 $A=|a|$，$T=2\pi/|b|$（弧度）或 $360^\circ/|b|$（角度）。

en.prompt: Without graphing find amplitude and period in radians and degrees: a)$y=-3\sin2x$; b)$y=4\cos0.5x$; c)$y=\frac13\sin(5x/6)$; d)$y=-5\cos(3x/2)$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Use $A=|a|$, $T=2\pi/|b|$ radians or $360^\circ/|b|$ degrees.

exercises.prompt: 说明如何区分并画图验证：a) $\sin x,\sin2x,2\sin x$；b) $\sin x,-\sin x,\sin(-x)$；c) $\cos x,-\cos x,\cos(-x)$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) $\sin x$振幅1周期 $2\pi$；$\sin2x$振幅1周期 $\pi$；$2\sin x$振幅2周期 $2\pi$。分别比较高度和重复次数。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: b) 正弦为奇函数，$\sin(-x)=-\sin x$，后两图重合，且是第一图关于x轴的反射。c) 余弦为偶函数，$\cos(-x)=\cos x$；负余弦关于x轴反射，初值−1而另两者初值1。

exercises.answer: 各函数的振幅、周期与奇偶关系见步骤与三组图。

en.prompt: Describe how to distinguish and graph to check: a) $\sin x,\sin2x,2\sin x$; b) $\sin x,-\sin x,\sin(-x)$; c) $\cos x,-\cos x,\cos(-x)$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) $\sin x$ has amplitude1/period $2\pi$; $\sin2x$ amplitude1/period $\pi$; $2\sin x$ amplitude2/period $2\pi$. Compare heights and repetition rates.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) Sine is odd, so $\sin(-x)=-\sin x$; the last two coincide and reflect the first in the x-axis. c) Cosine is even, $\cos(-x)=\cos x$; negative cosine is reflected in the x-axis and starts at −1 instead of1.

en.answer: See the amplitude/period/parity comparisons and three graph panels.

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 取正振幅系数；角度周期用 $b=360^\circ/T$，弧度周期用 $b=2\pi/T$。

en.prompt: Write an equation $y=a\cos bx$ for: a) A=3, T=π；b) A=4, T=150°；c) A=1/2, T=720°；d) A=3/4, T=π/6

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Choose positive a; use $b=360^\circ/T$ for degree periods and $b=2\pi/T$ for radian periods.

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 取正振幅系数；角度周期用 $b=360^\circ/T$，弧度周期用 $b=2\pi/T$。

en.prompt: Write an equation $y=a\sin bx$ for: a) A=8, T=180°；b) A=0.4, T=60°；c) A=3/2, T=4π；d) A=2, T=2π/3

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Choose positive a; use $b=360^\circ/T$ for degree periods and $b=2\pi/T$ for radian periods.

exercises.prompt: 求振幅、周期、相移、竖直平移，并各画两周期：a)$y=2\cos[3(x-\pi/2)]-8$；b)$y=\sin[\frac12(x-\pi/4)]+3$；c)$y=-4\cos[2(x-30^\circ)]+7$；d)$y=\frac13\sin[\frac14(x-60^\circ)]-1$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 由 $A=|a|$，$T=2\pi/|b|$或 $360^\circ/|b|$，直接从已因式分解的 $x-c$ 读取右移c。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: 各图从c至c+2T，按每隔T/4取点；余弦从 $a+d$ 起，正弦从中线d起。

exercises.answer: 四组参数与两周期图见步骤。

en.prompt: Find amplitude, period, phase shift, and vertical displacement and sketch two cycles: a)$y=2\cos[3(x-\pi/2)]-8$; b)$y=\sin[\frac12(x-\pi/4)]+3$; c)$y=-4\cos[2(x-30^\circ)]+7$; d)$y=\frac13\sin[\frac14(x-60^\circ)]-1$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Use $A=|a|$, $T=2\pi/|b|$ or $360^\circ/|b|$ and read right shift c from the factored $x-c$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: a) $A=2,T=2\pi/3,c=\pi/2,d=-8$; b)$A=1,T=4\pi,c=\pi/4,d=3$; c)$A=4,T=180^\circ,c=30^\circ,d=7$ with reflection; d)$A=1/3,T=1440^\circ,c=60^\circ,d=-1$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Plot from c to c+2T with points every T/4; cosine starts at a+d and sine at midline d.

en.answer: See all four parameter sets and two-cycle plots.

exercises.prompt: 同轴画 $f(x)=\cos[2(x-\pi/2)]$ 与 $g(x)=\cos(2x-\pi/2)$，$0\le x\le2\pi$。a) 各周期？b) 各相移？c) $y=\cos b(x-\pi)$ 相移？d) $y=\cos(bx-\pi)$ 相移？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 两者横向系数均2，周期π。b) f右移π/2；$g=\cos[2(x-\pi/4)]$，右移π/4。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: c) 相移π。d) 对 $b\ne0$，$bx-\pi=b(x-\pi/b)$，相移为有向量π/b；b<0时为左移。b=0为常数，通常不定义相移。

exercises.answer: a) 都π；b)右π/2、右π/4；c)π；d)π/b，b≠0。

en.prompt: Graph $f(x)=\cos[2(x-\pi/2)]$ and $g(x)=\cos(2x-\pi/2)$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$. a) Find periods. b) Find phase shifts. c) Phase shift of $y=\cos b(x-\pi)$? d) Phase shift of $y=\cos(bx-\pi)$?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Both have coefficient2 and periodπ. b) f shifts right π/2; $g=\cos[2(x-\pi/4)]$ shifts right π/4.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: c) Phase shift is π. d) For $b\ne0$, $bx-\pi=b(x-\pi/b)$, so signed shift is π/b (left if b<0). For b=0 the function is constant and phase shift is not normally defined.

en.answer: a) Both π; b) right π/2 and right π/4; c)π; d)π/b for b≠0.

exercises.prompt: 把所附a–d各图分别写成 $y=a\sin b(x-c)+d$ 与 $y=a\cos b(x-c)+d$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: b) 极值1、−3，A=2、中线−1，周期180°、在原点中线上升。$y=2\sin2x-1=2\cos[2(x-45^\circ)]-1$。

exercises.answer: a–d的两种等价方程见逐项步骤。

en.prompt: For each given graph a–d write an equation in both forms $y=a\sin b(x-c)+d$ and $y=a\cos b(x-c)+d$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Extrema4/−2 give A=3, midline1; period180° and minimum at0°. Thus $y=3\sin[2(x-45^\circ)]+1=-3\cos2x+1$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) Extrema1/−3 give A=2, midline−1; period180° and rising midline at0°. $y=2\sin2x-1=2\cos[2(x-45^\circ)]-1$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: c) Extrema1/−3 give A=2, midline−1, periodπ and minimum at0. $y=2\sin[2(x-\pi/4)]-1=-2\cos2x-1$.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: d) Extrema4/−2 give A=3, midline1, period4π, maximum at3π/2. $y=3\sin[\frac12(x-\pi/2)]+1=3\cos[\frac12(x-3\pi/2)]+1$.

en.answer: The two equivalent equations for each graph are given in the corresponding step.

exercises.prompt: a) 写正弦函数：A=4、T=π、右移π/3、下移5。b) 写余弦函数：A=0.5、T=4π、左移π/6、上移1。c) 写正弦函数：A=2/3、T=540°、无相移、下移5。

en.prompt: a) Write a sine function with A=4, T=π, right shift π/3, down5. b) Write a cosine with A=0.5, T=4π, left shiftπ/6, up1. c) Write a sine with A=2/3, T=540°, no phase shift, down5.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: c) $b=360/540=2/3$, so $y=\frac23\sin(2x/3)-5$, with x measured in degrees.

exercises.prompt: 分别画图并求定义域、值域、最大最小、x及y截距：a)$y=2\cos(x-45^\circ)+3$；b)$y=4\sin[2(x-\pi/3)]+1$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 全域实数；中线3、A=2，所以值域 $[1,5]$，最大5、最小1。因最低仍大于0无x截距；$y(0)=2\cos45^\circ+3=3+\sqrt2$。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: b) x截距满足 $\sin[2(x-\pi/3)]=-1/4$。令 $\alpha=\arcsin(-1/4)$，$x=\pi/3+\alpha/2+\pi n$ 或 $\pi/3+(\pi-\alpha)/2+\pi n$，$n\in\mathbb Z$。

exercises.answer: 全部特征与两族x截距见步骤；截距坐标应写 $(x,0)$ 与 $(0,y)$。

en.prompt: Graph each function and state domain, range, extrema, and x/y-intercepts: a)$y=2\cos(x-45^\circ)+3$; b)$y=4\sin[2(x-\pi/3)]+1$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Domain is real; midline3 and A=2 give range $[1,5]$, maximum5/minimum1. No x-intercepts because the minimum is positive; $y(0)=3+\sqrt2$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) Domain is real, range $[-3,5]$, maximum5/minimum−3; $y(0)=1-2\sqrt3$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: b) Zeros satisfy $\sin[2(x-\pi/3)]=-1/4$. Let $\alpha=\arcsin(-1/4)$; then $x=\pi/3+\alpha/2+\pi n$ or $\pi/3+(\pi-\alpha)/2+\pi n$, $n\in\mathbb Z$.

en.answer: All features and both zero families appear above; intercept coordinates are $(x,0)$ and $(0,y)$.

exercises.prompt: 用变换语言说明从基本正弦或余弦如何得到：a)$3\sin2(x-\pi/3)+6$；b)$-2\cos[\frac12(x+\pi/4)]-3$；c)$\frac34\cos2(x-30^\circ)+10$；d)$-\sin2(x+45^\circ)-8$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 正弦图横向压缩为1/2、纵向伸长3，右移π/3，上移6。b) 余弦横向伸长2、纵向伸长2并关于x轴反射，左移π/4，下移3。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: c) 余弦横向压缩1/2、纵向压缩3/4，右移30°、上移10。d) 正弦横向压缩1/2、关于x轴反射、左移45°、下移8。先相对原点伸缩再平移。

exercises.answer: a–d的完整变换见逐项步骤。

en.prompt: Describe transformations from basic sine or cosine to: a)$3\sin2(x-\pi/3)+6$; b)$-2\cos[\frac12(x+\pi/4)]-3$; c)$\frac34\cos2(x-30^\circ)+10$; d)$-\sin2(x+45^\circ)-8$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Compress sine horizontally by1/2, stretch vertically by3, shift rightπ/3 and up6. b) Stretch cosine horizontally by2 and vertically by2, reflect in the x-axis, shift leftπ/4 and down3.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: c) Compress cosine horizontally by1/2 and vertically by3/4, shift right30° and up10. d) Compress sine horizontally by1/2, reflect in the x-axis, shift left45° and down8. Apply scaling/reflection before translation.

en.answer: Complete transformations are given for a–d above.

exercises.prompt: 邮轮接近码头的声波 $y=2\sin2\theta$，离开时 $y=2\sin(\theta/2)$。a) 在 $0\le\theta\le2\pi$ 作图比较。b) 两者与 $y=\sin\theta$ 比较如何？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 两者振幅2；接近时周期π，所以图上2周期；离开时周期4π，所以图上半周期。前者更频繁振动，对应更高音高。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: b) 与基本正弦相比，两者均纵向伸长2；接近图横向压缩1/2，离开图横向伸长2；中线均0。

exercises.answer: 见三曲线；接近周期π，离开周期4π，振幅均2。

en.prompt: A cruise-ship horn has wave $y=2\sin2\theta$ approaching and $y=2\sin(\theta/2)$ departing. a) Compare graphs on $0\le\theta\le2\pi$. b) Compare each with $y=\sin\theta$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Both amplitudes are2. Approaching periodπ gives two displayed cycles; departing period4π gives half a cycle. The former oscillates more rapidly and represents higher pitch.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) Relative to basic sine, both stretch vertically by2. The approaching graph compresses horizontally by1/2; the departing graph stretches horizontally by2; both midlines are0.

en.answer: See the three curves: approach periodπ, departure period4π, both amplitude2.

exercises.prompt: a) 在 $-2\pi\le\theta\le2\pi$ 及 $-360^\circ\le\theta\le360^\circ$ 画 $y=\tan\theta$。b) 求 i)定义域 ii)值域 iii)y截距 iv)x截距 v)渐近线。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 正切等于正弦除余弦。i) 排除 $\theta=\pi/2+n\pi$（90°+180°n）；所绘域还要与闭区间相交。ii) 值域全部实数。iii) y截距(0,0)。

exercises.answer: 各特征见步骤；角度图与弧度图为相同曲线、横刻度以180°=π换算。

en.prompt: a) Graph $y=\tan\theta$ for $-2\pi\le\theta\le2\pi$ and $-360^\circ\le\theta\le360^\circ$. b) Find i) domain ii) range iii) y-intercept iv) x-intercepts v) asymptotes.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Tangent is sine divided by cosine. i) Exclude $\theta=\pi/2+n\pi$ (90°+180°n), and intersect with the plotted interval. ii) Range is all real numbers. iii) y-intercept is(0,0).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: iv) Zeros are $\theta=n\pi$ (180°n); displayed zeros are $-2\pi,-\pi,0,\pi,2\pi$ (−360°,−180°,0°,180°,360°). v) Displayed asymptotes are $\pm\pi/2,\pm3\pi/2$ (±90°,±270°). Each branch increases; do not join across asymptotes.

en.answer: See all characteristics above; relabel the same horizontal scale using180°=π for the degree graph.

exercises.prompt: 单位圆点 $P(\sqrt3/2,1/2)$，射线OP与 $x=1$ 的切线相交于Q（见图）。a) 求Q精确坐标。b) 说明sinθ、cosθ、tanθ关系。c) θ趋90°时tanθ怎样？d) θ=90°时怎样？

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: b) $\cos\theta=x_P,\sin\theta=y_P,\tan\theta=\sin\theta/\cos\theta$。c) 从左趋90°时Q沿切线上升无界，tanθ趋+∞；从右趋时为−∞。d) cos90°=0，所以正切无定义，不等于∞。

exercises.answer: a)$(1,\sqrt3/3)$；b–d)见步骤中的商关系、单侧极限与无定义。

en.prompt: On the unit circle $P(\sqrt3/2,1/2)$ lies on ray OP, which meets the tangent x=1 at Q (diagram shown). a) Find Q exactly. b) Relate sinθ, cosθ, tanθ. c) What happens to tanθ as θ approaches90°? d) At θ=90°?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Slope OP is $(1/2)/(\sqrt3/2)=1/\sqrt3$. At x=1, y=1/√3, so $Q=(1,\sqrt3/3)$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) $\cos\theta=x_P$, $\sin\theta=y_P$, $\tan\theta=\sin\theta/\cos\theta$. c) From the left Q rises without bound and tanθ tends to+∞; from the right it tends to−∞. d) cos90°=0, so tangent is undefined, not equal to infinity.

en.answer: a)$(1,\sqrt3/3)$; b–d) see the quotient relation, one-sided behaviour, and undefined value.

exercises.prompt: a) cosθ与正切渐近线有何关系？b) sinθ与正切x截距有何关系？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) $\tan\theta=\sin\theta/\cos\theta$，cosθ=0且sinθ=±1时出现竖直渐近线，位置 $\pi/2+n\pi$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: b) 当sinθ=0，cosθ=±1≠0，故正切为0；x截距为 $(n\pi,0)$。

exercises.answer: a)余弦零点给渐近线；b)正弦零点给正切零点。

en.prompt: a) How does cosθ relate to tangent’s asymptotes? b) How does sinθ relate to tangent’s x-intercepts?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) In $\tan\theta=\sin\theta/\cos\theta$, zeros of cosine have sine±1 and produce vertical asymptotes at $\pi/2+n\pi$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) At sine zeros, cosine is±1≠0, so tangent is0; x-intercepts are $(n\pi,0)$.

en.answer: a)Cosine zeros give asymptotes; b)sine zeros give tangent zeros.

exercises.prompt: 用太阳仰角与树高时可借助tanθ量影长。太阳正上方时影子怎样？这与正切图有什么关系？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 设树高H、影长s、太阳仰角θ，则 $\tan\theta=H/s$，所以 $s=H/\tan\theta$（0<θ<90°）。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: θ从左趋90°时，tanθ趋+∞而s趋0。正上方理想影长0；是tan的倒数给影长，不是tan本身趋0。

exercises.answer: 影长趋0，正切在90°处无定义并有竖直渐近线。

en.prompt: Tangent is used to find shadow lengths from a tree’s height and the Sun’s elevation. What happens with the Sun directly overhead, and how does this relate to the tangent graph?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: With height H, shadow s, and elevation θ, $\tan\theta=H/s$, hence $s=H/\tan\theta$ for0<θ<90°.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: As θ tends to90° from below, tanθ tends to+∞ while s tends to0. The ideal shadow vanishes; it is reciprocal tangent that gives shadow length.

en.answer: The shadow tends to0; tangent is undefined at90° with a vertical asymptote.

exercises.prompt: 什么是竖直渐近线？如何判断三角函数是否有竖直渐近线？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 若x趋某个有限值a时函数值至少从一侧无界，直线x=a为竖直渐近线。对于本章tan，检查分母cos为0且分子sin不为0的位置。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: 正弦余弦有界、全实数定义域，故本身无竖直渐近线；正切在 $x=\pi/2+n\pi$ 有渐近线。仅“某处无定义”并不足以证明渐近线，还须无界。

exercises.answer: 有限横坐标附近的无界行为给竖直渐近线；正切例为 $\pi/2+n\pi$。

en.prompt: What is a vertical asymptote, and how can you tell when a trigonometric function has one?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: If a function grows without bound on at least one side as x approaches a finite a, x=a is a vertical asymptote. For tangent, check where denominator cosine is0 while numerator sine is nonzero.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Sine and cosine are bounded with real domains and have no vertical asymptotes. Tangent has them at $x=\pi/2+n\pi$. Being undefined alone is insufficient; unbounded behaviour is needed.

en.answer: Unbounded behaviour near a finite input gives a vertical asymptote; tangent’s are $\pi/2+n\pi$.

exercises.prompt: 图解：a)$2\sin x-1=0$，$0\le x\le2\pi$；b)$0=2\cos(x-30^\circ)+5$，$0^\circ\le x\le360^\circ$；c)$\sin[\pi(x-6)/4]=0.5$，弧度通解；d)$4\cos(x-45^\circ)+7=10$，角度通解。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) sinx=1/2，一周期两个交点 $\pi/6,5\pi/6$。b) 余弦曲线值域[3,7]，不与y=0相交，故无解。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: d) $\cos(x-45^\circ)=3/4$，故 $x=45^\circ\pm\arccos(3/4)+360^\circ n$。

en.prompt: Solve graphically: a)$2\sin x-1=0$ on $0\le x\le2\pi$; b)$0=2\cos(x-30^\circ)+5$ on $0^\circ\le x\le360^\circ$; c)$\sin[\pi(x-6)/4]=0.5$, general radians solution; d)$4\cos(x-45^\circ)+7=10$, general degrees solution.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) sinx=1/2 gives two intersections $\pi/6,5\pi/6$. b) The cosine expression ranges from3 to7 and never intersects y=0, so no solution.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: d) $\cos(x-45^\circ)=3/4$, so $x=45^\circ\pm\arccos(3/4)+360^\circ n$.

en.answer: a)$\pi/6,5\pi/6$; b)no solution; c)$20/3+8n,28/3+8n$; d)about$3.590^\circ+360^\circ n$ or$86.410^\circ+360^\circ n$, integer n.

exercises.prompt: Victoria的Royal BC Museum建于1886年，为保护文物温度超过22°C时开空调。夏天 $T=12\cos t+19$，T(°C)、t(h)。a)画图。b)每天空调开多久（0.1 h）？c)为何温度模型重要？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 按原式弧度解释，振幅12、中线19、周期2π h；在0–24 h画图，不擅自补24小时系数。b) $T>22\Rightarrow\cos t>1/4$，令 $\alpha=\arccos(1/4)$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: 在一天内区间为 $[0,\alpha)$、$(2\pi n-\alpha,2\pi n+\alpha)$ (n=1,2,3)，以及 $(8\pi-\alpha,24]$。总长 $\alpha+6\alpha+24-(8\pi-\alpha)=8\alpha+24-8\pi$。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: c) 温度与湿度控制有助于保护文物，也帮助规划设备运行。原式周期不是24小时；若另设24小时日周期，则需改模型而不是改变原题的计算。

exercises.answer: b) 9.41219 h，约9.4 h；a,c)见图和解释。

en.prompt: The Royal BC Museum in Victoria, founded in1886, uses air conditioning above22°C to preserve artifacts. In summer $T=12\cos t+19$, T(°C), t(h). a)Graph it. b)How long per day is AC on, to0.1h? c)Why is temperature modelling important?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Under the literal radian interpretation, amplitude12, midline19, period2π h; plot0–24h without inserting a 24-hour frequency. b) $T>22\Rightarrow\cos t>1/4$; let $\alpha=\arccos(1/4)$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Within one day use $[0,\alpha)$, $(2\pi n-\alpha,2\pi n+\alpha)$ for n=1,2,3, and $(8\pi-\alpha,24]$. Total length is $8\alpha+24-8\pi$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: c) Temperature control helps preserve artifacts and plan equipment operation. The printed function does not have a 24-hour period; a daily-cycle assumption requires a different model, not an unannounced change to this calculation.

en.answer: b) 9.41219 h, about9.4 h; a,c)see plot and explanation.

exercises.prompt: 摩天轮乘客高 $h(t)=12\sin[\pi(t-30)/45]+15$，h米、t秒。a)画图。b)最高最低？c)一周时间？d)45s时高？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a,b) 中线15、振幅12，所以最高27m、最低3m。c)$T=2\pi/(\pi/45)=90$s。

en.prompt: A Ferris-wheel rider follows $h(t)=12\sin[\pi(t-30)/45]+15$, h metres, t seconds. a)Graph it. b)Find extrema. c)Time per revolution? d)Height at45s?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a,b) Midline15 and amplitude12 give maximum27m and minimum3m. c)$T=2\pi/(\pi/45)=90$s.

exercises.prompt: Lethbridge最长日6月21日日照15.7h，最短日12月21日8.3h。a)求日照L随时间的正弦模型。b)4月3日日照多少？

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: 4月3日为第93日，代入 $L(93)$。由于两极值日期相隔183而半365为182.5日，此为常用近似模型，不能声称两日期都精确对齐。

en.prompt: Lethbridge’s longest day is June21 with15.7h daylight and shortest is December21 with8.3h. a)Model daylight L versus time. b)Find daylight on April3.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Using non-leap-year day numbers, June21 is172 and December21 is355. A=(15.7−8.3)/2=3.7h, midline12h, T=365days; align the maximum: $L(t)=12+3.7\cos[2\pi(t-172)/365]$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: April3 is day93; substitute $L(93)$. Since the extreme dates differ by183 days while half365 is182.5, this conventional model is approximate rather than an exact alignment of both dates.

exercises.prompt: 太阳黑子每年数量周期地在10到110间；1750–1948有18整周期，1750为最大。a)预计2000年数量？b)2000年后首次约35个的年份？c)2000年后首次最大年份？

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: c) 最大在 $y=1750+11n$；大于2000的最小整数n为23，年份2003。

en.prompt: Sunspots vary periodically between10 and110 per year. There are18 complete cycles from1750 to1948, and1750 is a maximum. a)Predict the number in2000. b)Find the first year after2000 with about35. c)Find the first maximum year after2000.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: c) Maxima occur at $y=1750+11n$; the smallest integer n giving a year after2000 is23, hence2003.

en.answer: a)about53; b)about2006.667 (about2007); c)2003.
